source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The core of Yoga is in C++: YGNode and Style describe the tree, CalculateLayout and FlexLine compute the flexbox layout. Java/Kotlin go through JNI and JavaScript through WebAssembly, while gentest generates the tests from HTML fixtures.
